items.title: Global economy to slow less than expected in 2026 as AI boom offsets war hit: IMF
items.body: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, as AI investment helped offset the war’s energy shock.

items.title: Nobel prize in economics awarded to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford
items.body: The U.S. economists were awarded for work that underpins the models used by central banks and governments to stabilize the economy.

items.title: India’s retail inflation jumps to 5.54% in September, above estimates
items.body: India inflations jumps for the 11-straight month, raising prospects of a further interest rate hike

items.title: World Bank jobs council urges 'crisis-era' employment support measures as IMF warns of AI ‘tsunami’
items.body: IMF Chief Kristalina Georgieva warned AI is hitting the global labor market like a “slow-moving tsunami,” with young workers entering the job market the most exposed.

items.title: Americans' debt problems are flashing a warning not seen since the Great Recession
items.body: Researchers found that while wealth disparities narrowed somewhat, the ability to meet debt payments deteriorated significantly.

items.title: Treasury's Bessent hires Trump's controversial former Fed board pick, Judy Shelton, as advisor
items.body: Shelton's controversial economic ideas led the Senate to block her nomination to the Fed. Now she's going to be a counselor to the Treasury secretary.

items.title: Inflation on many everyday items was entirely due to tariffs, NY Fed says
items.body: Tariffs added 2.9 percentage points to inflation in 67 categories of goods by February 2026, researchers at the New York Federal Reserve found.

items.title: Inflation fears on the rise as one-year outlook in Fed survey hits highest level since May 2023
items.body: The Survey of Consumer Expectations indicated that the median outlook for inflation over the next 12 months rose to 3.9%.
